title: Wide Ball
intro: Every wide ball puts your groin at full length and asks it to take load. So it's worth training that position under load. We walk first, open the position, then load it. This is for a groin that's tight, not one that's strained. Stop and get it looked at if you've strained your groin in the last couple of months, if it grabs when you push off, if you have pain at the pubic bone or low in the belly, or if you feel a lump or bulge in the groin. If you get a sharp pinch at the front of the hip in the deep positions and it keeps happening, get that looked at too.

Do it on a light day. It leaves the adductors sore for about two days, so keep it two days clear of your next match and of speed or braking work on court. First time through, do just one set of each loaded exercise and see how you feel in two days. Tired or a bit sore is fine. Sharp, in one spot, or worse first thing in the morning means back off and get it looked at. You need something firm at about knee height for the Copenhagen, like a bench or a sturdy sofa seat. A chair only works pushed hard against a wall so it can't slide. Not a bed. An easy bike does the walk's job if you'd rather.

good: Walk at an easy pace with your arms swinging
Feel your hips and legs warming up
bad: Cutting the walk short before you feel warm

good: Sit tall and swing both knees across to the other side
Feel the turn happening deep in your hips
bad: Pushing your knees down with your hands

good: Kneel with one leg out to the side and rock your hips back toward your heels
Feel a gentle stretch along the inside of the straight leg
bad: Letting your lower back round as you rock back

good: Step wide and sit back into one hip, going a little deeper each rep
Feel the inside of the straight leg lengthen
bad: Letting the heel of the bent leg lift

exercises.name: Cossack Squat
exercises.note: Go only as deep as you can control and come up a little if the front of the hip pinches.

good: Sit deep into one hip with the other leg straight and its heel down
Feel the inside of the straight leg holding the stretch

exercises.name: Copenhagen Plank
exercises.note: Stop the set when your hips start to drop, even if that's before fifteen seconds.

good: Lie on your side with your top knee on a bench and lift your hips in a straight line
Feel the inside of the top thigh working hard
bad: Letting your hips sag toward the floor
